Your military base, which lies at the heart of your castle, needs to be developed. At first, you’ll have access to catapults and guardsmen, and later on, you’ll get even more units: titans, dragons, elementals, and other fantastic beasts will defend your stronghold, eliminate enemy troops, and conquer the world on your behalf. Summon the best captains to lead your warriors and achieve victory. Your skills as a kingdom-builder will determine the future, so do your best!
